profile.name: Rafael Campo
profile.title: DevOps and Cloud Security Engineer - AWS Infrastructure
profile.text: DevOps and Cloud Security Engineer with 6+ years securing and operating high-throughput AWS infrastructure for distributed systems serving 10K+ users. Hands-on across IAM and least-privilege access controls, VPC and network hardening, secrets management (KMS, Secrets Manager), CI/CD pipeline security, and incident response. Implemented SOC 2 compliance controls and built CloudWatch-based monitoring, alerting, and vulnerability scanning into production environments. Proven track record reducing AWS infrastructure costs by 67%, accelerating deployment velocity, and translating security risk into practical, lightweight action for engineering and leadership.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer and Cloud Solution Architect
achievements: Architected and hardened 10+ high-throughput AWS microservices (ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda) for 10K+ active users, enforcing least-privilege Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles and VPC network hardening, reducing AWS infrastructure costs by 67 percent (from 30K to 10K USD monthly) while maintaining sub-100ms latency across distributed systems.

Re-architected continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) deployment pipelines with embedded security controls during a monolith-to-microservices migration, reducing deployment time by 60 percent and increasing release frequency from weekly to on-demand (3+ weekly) with zero-downtime, parallel team deployments.

Engineered a production authentication layer in Clojure with OAuth and single sign-on (SSO) integration and JWT, securing 10K+ concurrent users across payment processing and semantic search services and integrating AWS Secrets Manager and KMS for secrets management and data protection.

Established CloudWatch observability, alerting, and incident response procedures for payment- and loyalty-critical services, sustaining 99.99 percent uptime and enabling rapid detection and remediation of security and reliability events.

Engineered Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) workflows across 50+ AWS resources and multiple environments, integrating vulnerability scanning and consistent security configuration into provisioning, reducing setup time by 80 percent and onboarding 12+ engineers.

jobs.title: Software Engineer and SOC 2 Implementation Lead
achievements: Implemented SOC 2 compliance controls across cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines, partnering with engineering and leadership to align IAM access controls, audit logging, and data protection with compliance audit requirements.

Engineered latency-sensitive Clojure backend services optimized for sub-50ms response times at 5K+ requests per second, applying secure-by-design and functional-correctness principles to harden high-throughput distributed systems.

Documented security recommendations and maintained lightweight playbooks for access management and incident handling, enabling the team to operate compliant processes without heavy operational overhead.

jobs.title: Implementation Analyst
achievements: Developed scalable, production-ready Python data integration solutions for enterprise clients, applying secure data handling and access-control practices across complex client workflows.
Contributed to database design and optimization strategies supporting complex data processing, ensuring system scalability, consistency, and reliable data integrity.

Cloud and Infrastructure: AWS (IAM, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, ECR, Bedrock)
